content: The function LinTp_Transmit shall return E_NOT_OK when the corresponding LinIf_ScheduleRequest call (called from BswM_LinTp_RequestMode resulting from the LinTp_Transmit call, see SWS_LinIf_00646 and [ SWS_LinIf_ 00641] ) returned E_NOT_OK for the Schedule Request.

The function LinTp_Transmit shall return E_NOT_OK when the corresponding LinIf_ScheduleRequest call (called from BswM_LinTp_RequestMode resulting from the LinTp_Transmit call, see SWS_LinIf_00646 and [ SWS_LinIf_ 00641] ) returned E_NOT_OK for the Schedule Request.

The function LinTp_Transmit shall return E_NOT_OK when the corresponding LinIf_ScheduleRequest call (called from BswM_LinTp_RequestMode resulting from the LinTp_Transmit call, see SWS_LinIf_00646 and [ SWS_LinIf_ 00641] ) returned E_NOT_OK for the Schedule Request.
